expectedResult: Focus order is logical, visible, and returns to the triggering control.
actualResult: DonHV physically executed the seven-step keyboard sequence and observed visible focus, control-to-control Tab navigation, Enter dialog opening, arrow-key composite-list navigation, dialog-action reachability, Escape close, and focus return to the trigger.
reviewBoundary: Final PASS approved under the parent-authorized physical-keyboard attestation; the historical Browser automation limitation remains preserved.

evidence.description: DonHV human attestation of the physical keyboard sequence; no simulated browser key result is claimed.

historicalAutomationLimitation.actualResult: Keyboard Enter opened Similar Bugs and Escape closed it; focus visibly returned to Find Similar Bugs. However, eight Tab key attempts from the focused trigger and one direct locator Tab press did not advance focus to the next control, so logical sequential navigation through classification, assignment, and comment could not be demonstrated.
historicalAutomationLimitation.reviewBoundary: This is a candidate keyboard-navigation failure with a Browser translation limitation noted. DonHV should reproduce manually before an approved FAIL/Jira decision.

evidence.description: Visible focus returned to Find Similar Bugs after keyboard-opened dialog was closed with Escape.

historicalAutomationLimitation.limitation: The approved Browser surface may translate Tab differently from a physical keyboard; DonHV manual confirmation is required before treating this as a confirmed accessibility defect.
